scope: Development validation only; shared reference CSV filtered before lookup
selection: Minimum household-macro mean requests among initially unresolved; exact ties smaller kappa
prior: alpha_i=kappa*6*max(Ridge_i,1e-8*max(mean(nonnegative Ridge in whole block),1e-12))/sum whole-block floored weights
conditioning: Alpha fixed for whole blocks; retain remaining coordinates original alpha after every observation
tie_break: Maximum one-query probability; minimum worst residual width; lowest index
